tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Work done Certificate for Single Similar work in any of the five financial years, Certified by Assistant conservator of forest or above the rank of officer of i.e., 2023-24 , 2024-25 & 2025-26 (50% cost of estimate cost) (Rs 15.50 lakhs)
Contractors registered in Bruhat Bangalore Mahanagara Palike or equivalent registration with CPWD / KPWD /FOREST/ Railways / MES/National Highway or any State Government Organizations
Annual Turnover of Rs 62 lakhs/- in any two of the financial years, i.e., 2023-24 , 2024-25 & 2025-26 Should submit Annual turnover statement Certified by Chartered Accountant
